Requirements You are broadcasting the Numbers Frequency

Traits Signal

While you broadcast Numbers, enemies in range take a −1 status penalty to Perception checks and Perception DCs in addition to the −1 status penalty to Will that Numbers already imposes. This is one penalty applied to a second statistic, not a second penalty; the two never add together on the same roll.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB4 — extends a base aura (Numbers' −1 to Will) that is itself unencoded. All three Frequency-track base auras (Numbers, Open Band, Requiem, and their action-card twins) ship "rules": [] despite describing at-will auras with real numbers. Buildable in principle via Aura + a companion effect (same shape as SB3), unbuildable in practice because no such companion item exists, and because the base aura's own radius/uptime is itself gated on the un-encoded Broadcast (SB3).
